n3251aa474a.headline: Do you have unpaid debts? Then you will not be able to do these things
n3251aa474a.summary: A recent survey found that 92% of Poles consider repaying debts a moral obligation, with unpaid debts limiting access to various services.
n3251aa474a.why: Consumer debt levels and repayment behavior affect credit markets, financial stability, and economic activity in Poland.

n1cbed80c25.headline: Recovery at risk, Confindustria: "In January production sharply declined due to energy price increases". And half of companies expect nothing from the Recovery plan
n1cbed80c25.summary: Italian industrial production declined 1.3% in January following a 0.7% drop in December, driven by a 450% increase in electricity prices and rising raw material costs compressing company margins.
n1cbed80c25.why: Italy is a major European economy where industrial production is a key growth indicator; energy costs significantly impact manufacturing profitability and economic recovery.

n417c20abfb.headline: Electricity price rises slightly this Saturday but remains below 200 euros/MWh
n417c20abfb.summary: Spanish electricity prices increased slightly on Saturday, with peak prices between 19:00 and 20:00 and minimum prices between 15:00 and 16:00, staying below 200 euros per MWh.
n417c20abfb.why: Electricity prices affect industrial costs and consumer bills, influencing inflation and economic activity in Spain.
